title: Dating App Verification
scenario: A match says they will meet only after you verify through a paid safety site.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Dating App Verification: the trap is to turn familiarity or emotion into compliance. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Third-party dating verification links are often payment traps.
